title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Surrender Count on Types With and Without Telex Release
content:
This page fixes the figure entered on a full-set surrender at origin for a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` telex release, taking into account whether the document type offers the telex release at all.

## Rule

1. **Type must offer the service.** Originals are counted for a full-set surrender only on a document type that offers a telex release. On any other type the figure is zero.
2. **Joint requirement.** The figure equals the reconciled number of originals still circulating only when the type offers the telex release and the cargo behind the document counts as shipped. If either requirement fails, the figure is zero.
3. **Unit.** The figure counts whole original documents.

## Truth table

| Type offers telex release | Cargo counts as shipped | Figure entered |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Reconciled originals still circulating |
| Yes | No | 0 |
| No | Yes | 0 |
| No | No | 0 |

## Points of judgement

**A document of a type without telex release has three originals circulating. What figure would a full-set surrender carry?** Zero, because the type does not offer the service.

**The type offers telex release and the booking is loaded, with two originals still circulating. What figure is entered?** Two.
